description: Create an internet connectivity troubleshooting log. Your internet has been unreliable for weeks and your ISP claims 'no problems detected'. Create a systematic log with columns: Date, Time, Issue Type, Download Speed (Mbps), Upload Speed (Mbps), Expected Speed (Mbps), Duration (minutes), Devices Affected, Activity When Occurred, and Troubleshooting Tried. Enter at least 8 sample incident records. Add summary statistics (Total Incidents, Average Downtime, Average Download Speed, Service Reliability %). Apply conditional formatting to highlight slow speeds (< 250 Mbps) in red and long outages (> 30 min) in orange. Save as internet_log.xlsx.
